title: Common definitions
description: Shared building blocks reused by every content schema (US-010, extended by US-015). Content contract schemaVersion 2.

Id.description: Stable, globally unique, URL-safe identifier. Dotted hierarchy by convention: <family>.<kind>.<slug>. See AUTHORING.md.

ModuleId.description: Selection stage the content belongs to.

Version.description: Entity version. Starts at 1, bumped by the author whenever the entity's meaning changes (correct answer, wording that changes the answer, removed option...). Cosmetic fixes do not bump it.

Difficulty.description: 1 = trivial warm-up ... 5 = hardest expected at the real test. Scale defined in AUTHORING.md.

Tag.description: Dotted lowercase tag, e.g. english.grammar.tenses. Vocabulary per family in AUTHORING.md.

LocalizedText.description: Text shown to the user, keyed by UI locale. `fr` is mandatory and is the fallback for every other locale. For English-language stimuli (English test) put the English sentence under `fr` too: `fr` means 'what a French-UI user sees', not 'French text'.

LocalizedPath.description: Same shape as LocalizedText but each value is a path to a file relative to the module folder (used by lessons).

AssetPath.description: Path relative to assets/content/<module>/ (no leading slash, no '..').

MediaRef.description: Reference to a bundled media file. Vector (SVG) preferred for figures; PNG/JPEG only for photos; audio for listening items.

alt.description: Accessibility text; mandatory for images that carry information.

width.description: Intrinsic width in px (raster) or viewBox units (svg); optional layout hint.

Confidence.description: How sure we are that a value mirrors the real test (from the US-080 research doc).

Lang.description: Language of the stimulus itself (not of the UI). Used for text direction, hyphenation, TTS and sampling.

Meta.description: Authoring metadata, never shown to the user.

source.description: Free-text provenance (book, own creation, research doc section). Never copy copyrighted test material. Prefer `sources` for anything with a URL.

sources.description: Structured, dated references (v2). Expected on culture_aero items: where the fact comes from and when it was checked.

Source.description: One dated reference. `title` is mandatory; `url` and `accessedOn` when the source is online.

Status.description: draft entities pass validation but are not seeded into the app.

GridSize.description: Rows x columns of a grid (memory patterns, overlay boards, arithmetic grids).

Cadence.description: Fixed inter-stimulus rhythm (v2). The runtime shows each stimulus for `stimulusMs`, then accepts an answer for `answerWindowMs`; no answer = error. Used by memory_nback and attention_rules.

ScoringPolicy.description: Points per item outcome (v2). Default {1, 0, 0}. The historical culture test used {3, -1, 0} with a 'je ne sais pas' skip (realism option, US-063).

skip.description: Points for an explicit skip (McqItem.allowSkip) or a timeout.

InputRequirement.description: Input device the activity needs to be representative (v2). keyboard = physical keys (attention_rules, multitask_psychomotor); touch adaptations are labelled 'non-representative'.
